r43.opening: We will compare the transfer methods, then follow an owned PostgreSQL 17.6-to-18.6 copy-mode rehearsal. Its shop begins with orders 101–103, their original lines and payments, and stock P3 10/P7 0/P9 4. Anonymous request probes show whether either copy is missing accepted work.
